[["EVT06", 0, "IRS Notice 2026-61 (released 2026-09-21) extends the section 871(m) phase-in through 2028: only delta-one transactions are in scope, and the QDD net-delta relief and the simplified combination standard run to the end of 2028. Index swaps on a qualified index such as the S&P 500 stay outside 871(m), so the fund-level withholding of about 0% on this swap line does not change. TAX03 already charges for dependence on this one rule. Mayer Brown notes this may be the last relief notice before new regulations, so the next notice or proposed regulation is the item to watch. No adverse change.", "https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-drop/n-26-61.pdf"]]

[["EVT07", 0, "MSCI consultation proposes moving the MSCI Indonesia Indexes from EM to Standalone status, with feedback until 2027-04-30 and a decision on or before 2027-06-30. MSCI expects to proceed absent clear evidence of improvement, and an index-change freeze on Indonesian securities has applied since Jan 2026. Indonesia is 0.43% of MSCI EM, far below the 5% CON04 gate. The same applies to IEMA.L. FTSE kept Indonesia at Secondary Emerging on 2026-10-06, so VWRA and VFEA are not affected.", "https://www.msci.com/downloads/documents/indexes/consultations/equity/Indonesia_Consultation_Oct_26.pdf"]]
